risks.title: Supply constraints limiting gaming revenue growth
risks.quote: we expect supply constraints to be the headwind to gaming in Q1 and beyond
risks.explanation: Management explicitly states supply constraints will negatively impact gaming revenue in the upcoming quarter and beyond, representing a quantifiable headwind to growth.

risks.title: Demand uncertainty in China market
risks.quote: we have yet to generate any revenue and we do not know whether any imports will be allowed into China
risks.explanation: Management states they have not generated revenue from China and do not know if imports will be allowed, indicating a quantifiable uncertainty about future revenue potential in a major market.

risks.title: Chinese competitors disrupting global AI industry
risks.quote: our competitors in China, bolstered by recent IPOs, are making progress and have the potential to disrupt the structure of the global AI industry over the long-term
risks.explanation: Management identifies Chinese competitors with IPO backing as having potential to disrupt the global AI industry structure, representing a quantifiable competitive threat.

risks.title: Execution risk in Vera Rubin ramp
risks.quote: It's too early yet to determine how much in terms of that Vera Rubin, that beginning ramp will start in the second half
risks.explanation: Management acknowledges uncertainty about the timing and scale of Vera Rubin's ramp, which is critical for future growth, though no specific quantification is provided.

risks.title: Customer CapEx dependency and economic vulnerability
risks.quote: many investors are concerned that it would be harder for this level to grow into next year. And for several of them, their cash flow generation capability is also getting compressed
risks.explanation: Management acknowledges investor concerns about cloud customers' ability to sustain CapEx growth due to compressed cash flows, representing a quantifiable macroeconomic risk to NVIDIA's revenue outlook.
